actions.name: compress
actions.title: Compress PDF
actions.description: Make a PDF smaller, at a level or under a target size. The target is checked on the final file; the receipt says whether it was met.

actions.name: merge
actions.title: Merge PDFs
actions.description: Join PDFs into one, in the order given. Each file gets a bookmark with its name.

actions.name: split
actions.title: Split PDF
actions.description: Split a PDF into parts, by page ranges or by a largest part size. Returns a ZIP, so it must be the last step.

actions.name: rotate
actions.title: Rotate pages
actions.description: Turn all pages, one page, or a range, by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise.

actions.name: delete_pages
actions.title: Delete pages
actions.description: Remove the listed pages (1-based).

actions.name: extract_pages
actions.title: Extract pages
actions.description: Keep only the listed pages (1-based), as one PDF.

actions.name: reorder_pages
actions.title: Reorder pages
actions.description: Put pages in a new order: [3, 1, 2] makes page 3 first. Pages left out are dropped.

actions.name: page_numbers
actions.title: Add page numbers
actions.description: Number the pages. format uses %d twice: "Page %d of %d".

actions.name: watermark
actions.title: Add a text watermark
actions.description: Stamp text across every page.

actions.name: grayscale
actions.title: Convert to gray
actions.description: Turn every color in the PDF to shades of gray.

actions.name: protect
actions.title: Add a password
actions.description: Lock the PDF with a password needed to open it.

actions.name: unlock
actions.title: Remove a password
actions.description: Open a locked PDF with its password and save it without one.

actions.name: flatten
actions.title: Flatten forms and annotations
actions.description: Burn form fields and annotations into the page so they can't be changed.

actions.name: repair
actions.title: Repair PDF
actions.description: Rebuild a damaged PDF's structure so it opens again.

actions.name: crop
actions.title: Crop pages
actions.description: Keep a rectangle of every page: x and y of its top-left corner, then width and height, in PDF points.

actions.name: n_up
actions.title: Pages per sheet
actions.description: Put 2, 4, 6, 8, 9 or 16 pages on each sheet, or lay pages out as a booklet.

actions.name: to_pdfa
actions.title: Convert to PDF/A
actions.description: Make an archival PDF/A file (level 1b, 2b or 3b). 2b by default.

actions.name: ocr
actions.title: OCR: make scans searchable
actions.description: Add a text layer to scanned pages so they can be searched and copied.

actions.name: pdf_to_word
actions.title: PDF to Word
actions.description: An editable .docx that keeps the layout. Ends the job.

actions.name: pdf_to_markdown
actions.title: PDF to Markdown
actions.description: The text as Markdown, for pipelines and models. Ends the job.

actions.name: pdf_to_images
actions.title: PDF to images
actions.description: Every page as a PNG or JPEG, in a ZIP. Ends the job.

actions.name: pdf_to_epub
actions.title: PDF to EPUB
actions.description: A reflowable e-book. Ends the job.

actions.name: office_to_pdf
actions.title: Word, Excel or PowerPoint to PDF
actions.description: Convert .docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf, .xlsx, .xls, .ods, .pptx, .ppt or .odp to PDF. First step only.

actions.name: image_to_pdf
actions.title: Images to PDF
actions.description: One page per image, in the order given (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, TIFF). First step only.

actions.name: epub_to_pdf
actions.title: EPUB to PDF
actions.description: Lay an e-book out as a PDF. First step only.

actions.name: html_to_pdf
actions.title: Web page or HTML to PDF
actions.description: Render a public web page, or HTML you send, to PDF. Takes no input file, so it is the first step of a job with no inputs.

actions.name: create_pdf
actions.title: Create a PDF from Markdown, HTML or data
actions.description: Write the content, get a well-set PDF: Markdown or HTML, a template (plain, report, invoice, letter, resume) in a quiet or classic style, page size, margins, header, footer and page numbers. Or send an invoice's, resume's or letter's fields as data and we lay it out; an invoice is added up and checked. Takes no input file.

heading.description: Printed at the top. Default "Invoice"; e.g. "Tax invoice", "Quote".

currency.description: An ISO code ("USD", "NPR") for proper formatting, or a symbol ("Rs.").

quantity.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

unit_price.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

subtotal.description: Left out: the lines added up.

tax.description: Left out: tax_rate of the subtotal after discount.

shipping.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

total.description: Left out: subtotal − discount + tax + shipping.

contact.description: Email, phone, city, links: one line, in order.

body.description: Markdown; a blank line starts a paragraph.

data.description: Instead of markdown/html: the fields of an invoice, resume or letter (set template to match). We lay it out; for an invoice we also add up the lines, tax and total and report anything that doesn't add up.

actions.name: redact
actions.title: Redact
actions.description: Remove content for real, not just cover it: rectangles you give (areas), or every occurrence of text you name (text). Text redaction is checked on the result: if any of it can still be found, the step fails and nothing is returned.

actions.name: sign
actions.title: Sign
actions.description: Stamp a signature image (PNG or JPEG, uploaded as a file) on a page: at a named spot, or at x and y in points from the top-left corner. Width in points; the height follows the image.

actions.name: metadata
actions.title: Edit or remove document properties
actions.description: Set the title, author, subject and keywords, or remove every property.

actions.name: bookmarks
actions.title: Set bookmarks
actions.description: Replace the bookmarks (outline) with your own: a title and a page each, nested by level (0 = top).

actions.name: pdf_to_excel
actions.title: PDF to Excel
actions.description: Tables to a spreadsheet. mode tables: detected from the page, no AI. mode ai: a model reads the tables (scans too). mode statement: bank statements as one checked sheet, totals compared with the statement's own. Ends the job.

actions.name: extract_images
actions.title: Extract images
actions.description: Every image in the PDF, at its own resolution, in a ZIP. Ends the job.

actions.name: pdf_to_latex
actions.title: PDF to LaTeX
actions.description: A .tex file (zipped with an images folder when the PDF has pictures). Ends the job.

mcp_tools.name: search_docs

mcp_tools.description: Search the FynePDF API and MCP documentation: actions, parameters, pricing, files, jobs and errors.

mcp_tools.name: list_actions

mcp_tools.description: Every action FynePDF can run on a file (the REST API's job steps), with what it takes, what it makes and its price in API credits.

mcp_tools.name: upload_file
mcp_tools.title: Upload a file
mcp_tools.description: Bring a file into FynePDF. Shows a drop zone where the app supports it (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code); it takes several files at once, e.g. for a merge, and reports their file_ids in order. With file_name and size_bytes it also returns a signed upload_url and a ready curl command, for a code sandbox or agent to PUT the bytes; the file_id works once the upload is done. ChatGPT users can just pass the attached file to any tool instead.

mcp_tools.title: Import a file from a URL
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a PDF, Office file, image or EPUB from a public link into FynePDF and get its file_id.

mcp_tools.name: get_file
mcp_tools.title: Get a file
mcp_tools.description: A file's details and a fresh download link (valid 1 hour).

mcp_tools.title: List Library files
mcp_tools.description: Files saved in the person's FynePDF Library, newest first (pinned on top). Pass an id as library_file_id to any tool.

mcp_tools.name: save_to_library
mcp_tools.title: Save to Library
mcp_tools.description: Keep a result in the person's FynePDF Library (fynepdf.com/library), so it isn't deleted after 24 hours.

mcp_tools.title: Merge PDFs
mcp_tools.description: Join PDFs into one, in the order given (file_ids, then files, then file_urls). Each part gets a bookmark with its name.

mcp_tools.name: create_pdf
mcp_tools.title: Create a PDF
mcp_tools.description: Turn Markdown or HTML you write into a well-set PDF: a report, invoice, letter, resume or plain document. Tables, headings, lists, images by URL and page breaks work; header, footer and page numbers are optional. For an invoice, resume or letter, prefer data (the fields, with template set to match): it is laid out properly, and an invoice is added up for you (leave out amounts, subtotal, tax or total to have them worked out; give them and they are checked). extract_data's invoice result can be passed as data as it is. Use it whenever the person wants a document they can download, print or send.

heading.description: Printed at the top. Default "Invoice"; e.g. "Tax invoice", "Quote".

currency.description: An ISO code ("USD", "NPR") for proper formatting, or a symbol ("Rs.").

quantity.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

unit_price.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

subtotal.description: Left out: the lines added up.

tax.description: Left out: tax_rate of the subtotal after discount.

shipping.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

total.description: Left out: subtotal − discount + tax + shipping.

contact.description: Email, phone, city, links: one line, in order.

body.description: Markdown; a blank line starts a paragraph.

data.description: Instead of markdown/html: the fields of an invoice, resume or letter (set template to match). We lay it out; for an invoice we also add up the lines, tax and total and report anything that doesn't add up.

style.description: quiet (default): modern sans, gray labels. classic: serif, fine rules, centered heads; suits letters and traditional CVs.
